title: The Broken Script Language Override
description: This Resourcepack fixes the language bug with TBS
body:
# This pack only edits the US variant

> **To use it you have to equip it, go into Language, and search for "English Override (United States Overrided)".**

> _Thank you for downloading my Resource Pack_
 
> This can also be used incase of any in game glitches affecting the language
